label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 142

obligations.text:
(2)
An information notice must state—
(a)
whether it is given under subsection (1)(a), (b)(i) or (b)(ii), and
(b)
why the Commission requires the information or documents.

(b)
may specify the form in which the information or documents must be provided;

(c)
may specify the time at which, or the period within which, the information or documents must be provided;

(d)
may specify the place where the information or documents must be provided;

(4)
An information notice must provide information about—
(a)
the consequences of failure to comply with it, and
(b)
the rights under sections 162 and 164 (appeals etc).

(7)
If an information notice—
(a)
states that, in the Commission's opinion, the informationor documents are required urgently, and
(b)
gives the Commission's reasons for reaching that opinion,
subsections (5) and (6) do not apply but the notice must not require the information or documents to be provided before the end of the period of 24 hours beginning when the notice is given.
